summary.zh-TW: 主線用「從報表倒推」學會計，這一章補上會計人員記帳的那一層：每一筆交易寫成一筆分錄，左邊叫借方、右邊叫貸方，兩邊金額永遠相等；再把分錄過到 T 字帳、算出餘額，對回三張報表。第一關先用教學卡說明，再動手寫分錄。本章不列入期中考範圍。
summary.en: The main path learns accounting by working back from the statements; this chapter adds the layer the bookkeeper works in. Every transaction is written as a journal entry, with a left side called debit and a right side called credit that always total the same; the entries are then posted to T-accounts, balanced, and traced back to the three statements. The first level opens with a teaching card before you write entries yourself. This chapter is not in the midterm scope.
